author: tomas-okafor
title: Review of PR 142: what about month-end load?
body:
The race explanation makes sense and I am happy to lose a dependency. My worry is month-end. Settlement volume roughly triples on the last business day and the matcher reads a balance for every open account.

Did you test with month-end shaped load, or only an average Tuesday? An extra 12 ms is fine, but I would like to know it stays small when Postgres is busy.
